description:
Deploy a micropage build to the project's public URL. This changes what visitors see, so only call it when the user explicitly asks to publish, and pass confirm: true.

Defaults to the active build (the draft save_page just wrote); pass `build` with the id save_page returned to be exact, or an older build number to roll back to it (that build becomes active). Refused while another build of the project is still publishing.

It returns at once with status publishing, after_event_id and an ETA (builds wait about 3 minutes in the queue unless the account is Pro+). Then call get_deploy_status with that build and after_event_id to follow it to the end. It does not save source; call save_page first.

build.description: Which build to publish: the id save_page returned ("id:4567") or a build number ("v12" or 12). Defaults to the project's active build. Naming an older build republishes that snapshot and makes it the active build.

confirm.description: Must be true. Publishing changes the public site; ask the user before setting it.

project.description: Which project: its uuid, its numeric id, its micropage hostname ("acme" or "acme.micropage.sh") or its custom domain ("www.acme.com"). A full URL also works. Get valid values from list_projects.

name: publish_build

active_build_changed.description: True when the named build was not the active build and was made active.

after_event_id.description: Pass to get_deploy_status so it only reports events from this publish.

previous_status.description: The build's status before this publish.

eta_seconds.description: Rough time until the site is live.

title: Publish a build to the live site
